description: Get Transaction by ID. The "Get Transaction by ID" API allows to retrieve information for a specific transaction using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single transaction based on the provided transaction ID.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_getTransactionById
